text: Gandraor is a Blizzard employee as French Online Community Representative, but he also posts on Spanish forums because he has both French and Spanish nationalities. He is famous for his special ability to close threads with this sentence : "Sujet englouti" (Subject submerged). Gandraor was the first OCR in the French community team.
The Gallinas are a family of wine-sellers located in Stormwind City. They own and run the Gallina Winery, from which they conduct their trade. The family consists of the following members: * * *
__NOTOC__ Galar'thus Rivertree was a member of the Moon Guard during the War of the Ancients up until the third invasion.
__NOTOC__ Galendror Whitewing is a high elf flight master located at Windrunner's Overlook in Crystalsong Forest.
Galley Chief Paul Kubit is the galley chief of the Assurance found in Stormwind Harbor of Stormwind City. He is a bread, fish, spice and drink vendor.
Gallina Winery is a wine shop found in the Canals district in Stormwind City. It is owned and run by the Gallina family.

Gallywix Docks is a port located in the northwest on the largest of the Lost Isles. These docks were taken from the Town-In-A-Box by the Trade Prince and placed in their current location on the island. By the time players reach the docks Gallywix has already had a new yacht built and ready to go. This is where the final confrontation with Gallywix takes place.

Gallywix's Yacht is a goblin yacht docked near Gallywix's Villa in northwestern Bilgewater Port in Kezan. During the escape from the island, when the volcano erupted, Trade Prince Gallywix offered everyone a chance to survive... for a price. Later on, when the ship was at sea, an Alliance vessel engaged and sank the yacht. Its final resting place is at Shipwreck Shore on the Lost Isles.

Galewatch Lighthouse is a lighthouse situated on a large rocky island in the furthest northern reaches of Gilneas. It sits northwest of the Northern Headlands and northeast of the Headlands. There are several smashed boats lying in the sand on its small beach and a long, winding path lit with lanterns leading to its top. All the doors are closed, and there appear to be no inhabitants or mobs in the area. There is no incentive to go here during the worgen starting experience. In the Ruins of Gilneas the subzone is not displayed.
Gallaran's was a shop in the blood elven capital of Silvermoon. It was probably a jeweler-shop.

Gam was a tauren who used to hunt centaurs with Baine Bloodhoof. When the Emerald Nightmare fell into Thunder Bluff, Gam, dreaming, attacked Baine as if he were a centaur. Baine had no other choice than to drive a spear into Gam's chest and his body fell off from a bridge, disappearing into the accursed mists and thus saving Baine from watching his friend's body shatter.
Galeheart is Taelia Fordragon's gryphon. She was given to Taelia by Cyrus Crestfall when she was just a hatchling. She is the flight master of the Shrine of the Storm for the Alliance.

Galena Stormspear is a young tauren druid of the Cenarion Circle. At a young age, Galena was taught a lesson to not be hasty and sloppy when her mother sent her to fetch water from a well with a special water jug, an heirloom of the family. The land was wet and she rushed because she wanted to attend her grandfather Otue's stories in Thunder Bluff. She fell and broke the jug. From now on, she was always careful. When she showed her druidic abilities, she left Mulgore to join the Circle. Later, a Cenarion Circle acolyte in Feralas took her as an apprentice. When Master Thal'darah gave word that he is looking for a new apprentice, Galena quickly joined him in Thal'darah Overlook in Stonetalon
Gale Slash is an ability used by battle pets during a Pet Battle.
Gan'arg Technicians are gan'arg located in Shadowmoon Valley.

Gallywix's Hobgoblin is a hobgoblin located Atal'Dazar in Zuldazar during Chasing Gallywix. When Magister Umbric and the Alliance champion found Jastor, the trade prince and the hobgoblin ran into the Gallywix's Personal Teleporter, taking them to the Gallywix Pleasure Palace in Azshara.
The Gamma Pylon is located in the Rustbolt on Mechagon Island.
Galefury is a bound air elemental located in Island Expeditions.
Galvanizing Nimbus is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Galerider Poleaxe is sold by Storm Hunter William in Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City and Storm Huntress Suhrakka at Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar for during the Tempest Unleashed event.
Galepiercer Ballista is sold by Storm Hunter William in Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City and Storm Huntress Suhrakka at Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar for during the Tempest Unleashed event.

Galerider Crescent is sold by Storm Hunter William in Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City and Storm Huntress Suhrakka at Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar for during the Tempest Unleashed event.
Gaining an Advantus is a profession achievement earned by empowering yourself with a Vantus Rune 5 times while participate in the encounter.
Gargoyles are large, vicious bat-like creatures from Northrend who have the ability to temporarily turn to stone. Most of them serve the Undead Scourge.

Garments of the Moon is an Alliance only priest quest in Teldrassil, the night elf starting zone. In this quest, players are sent by Laurna Morninglight the priest trainer to heal and fortify a wounded Sentinel, just south of Dolanaar. Note that only priests can receive this quest. In Favor of Elune Is not required for this quest, but cannot be completed once this quest is completed.

Garithos' Elite Guard, commanded by Lord Garithos, was used to try to keep the blood elves and naga under Kael'thas Sunstrider and Lady Vashj from escaping to Outland through the Portal to Outland in Dalaran. His elite forces were made up of Alliance military, heroes, mercenaries, experiments and even red dragons. The main Elite Guard were released from his Castle, Barracks, Workshop and Gryphon Aviary. His heroes came from an Altar of Kings. His mercenaries were hired from Mercenary Camps. His red dragon allies came from a Dragon Roost. He released his experiments from Arcane Vaults. Garadar Defenders are level 70 elite guards stationed throughout the Mag'har city of Garadar in Nagrand.

Garm's Rise is located on a hill above and to the east of the main cave at Garm in the southern foothills of the Storm Peaks. It is northwest of Voltarus in Zul'Drak. A teleporter is located at its eastern end.

This robe at first appears stitched from a single sheet of thick grey leather. Once the robe is activated, its wearer goes through a remarkable transformation. Used amongst the dwarven guardians of the Ironforge clans, the gargoyle robe is a formidable protective item. The robe gives the wearer the power to assume the form of a stone statue resembling a gargoyle.

Garl Stormclaw is a worgen druid training with Zen'Aliri under Ithis Moonwarden. Garl spends most of his time gathering reagents for his druid rituals, and studying the plant life in Un'Goro Crater for the Cenarion Circle.

The royal garden area (or courtyard) of Stormwind Keep is found to the left when entering the throne room. Stormwind citizens make good use of the gardens, but Mathias Shaw thinks it's a dangerous place, and asked Varian and Anduin to take some precautions about it. However, neither of the two kings gave credit to the concerns of the Spymaster. The entrance to the Royal Library is here, and the ledges overlook the Stormwind City Outskirts, where the Eastern Earthshrine can be seen.

The Garrison Hearthstone is a quest reward from Establish Your Garrison. It functions as a secondary :Hearthstone for the Garrison, leaving players the ability to bind their primary hearth wherever they please.

fighting a garn, as seen in Lords of War.]] Garn are a species of massive, black wolves that are native to Frostfire Ridge on Draenor. According to Maraad, they are amongst the most vicious and cunning predators on Draenor. They always hunt in packs. Explorers in Frostfire Ridge should be wary of the frostwolf's undomesticated cousin, the dangerous garn. These enormous beasts, twice the mass of an Azerothian bear, are identified by their massive jaws and jet-black fur. Even the Frostwolf orcs fear the unruly and wild garn. The garn are primarily known for their ferocity, but they are only slightly lesser well known for their sumptuous furry pelts. The clans had brought their domesticated gar
Gargoyle Strike is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Gargash the Diver is an orc flight master located at Vol'mar in Tanaan Jungle.
Garhal the Scalekeeper is a vrykul flight master located at Valdisdall in Stormheim.

The Garden of the Moon is an extension of the Temple of Elune and where the Tear of Elune was kept. It is located at the edge of the Nightmare-corrupted roots of Shaladrassil. Gravax the Desecrator and the forces of the Nightmare assault the Temple of Elune from here.
Gargantuan Blighthound is a skeletal hound encountered during Island Expeditions.
Garadrath is an annihilan located in Highmountain during Legion Assaults.
Garrison Marksmen are jungle trolls summoned by the Call to Arms ability on .
The Gardener's Flute is located in the Garden of Night in the Ardenweald. It is used to restore Twinklestar's Gardening Toolkit.
The Gardener's Basket is located by a small pool in the Garden of Night in Ardenweald. It is used to restore Twinklestar's Gardening Toolkit.
Gargantuan Venomscale is a hydra located in Island Expeditions.

The Garden of Night, also called the Queen's Garden, is an area to the southwest of the dream tree of the Heart of the Forest. It was once personally tended to by the Winter Queen. The fae Twinklestar once tended to the garden and was it's historian containing its history in the Diary of the Night until the garden was taken over by Sicklethorn spriggans. Usually the Wild Hunt keeps them in check, but due to the various complications in the forest, Qadarin and Thiernax have been personally tending to the garden with Droman Aliothe helping sometimes.
Gatekeeper Kordurus is a keeper of the grove who guards the entrance to the Talon Den in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Gauntlets of Annihilation are very powerful plate melee DPS gloves.
__NOTOC__ Garul is a draenei fruit and drink vendor located in the Aldor Rise inn in Shattrath City.
Gauntlets of Ogre Strength drop from Boulderfist Enforcers at Boulder'gor and within Boulderfist Outpost in the Arathi Highlands. The item drops from Boulderfist Ogres in the Arathi Highlands.
Gatekeeper's Key can be found in the Gatekeeper's Hold which is hidden in a lantern at the entrance to Talon Den in the Stonetalon Mountains.

Garvin the Goblin is a goblin engineer working in Area 52. Although not present in-game, he manufactured the Seaforium PU-36 Explosive Nether Modulator, used to fight the Burning Legion by destroying gateways.

The Gauntlet is located inside Stratholme's Scourge side, just past a gate leading from Elders' Square. It leads on to Slaughter Square, which is barred from entry until all the ziggurats' defenders have been slain. The Gauntlet holds numerous perpetually burning buildings, including Legacy of Steel - Fine Weaponry, Enoyls Engineering, Inc., Chilton's Magic Shop and Cash & Sons - Pawn Brokers. It is the location of Stonespine, Nerub'enkan, Baroness Anastari, the Black Guard Swordsmith, Maleki the Pallid, and Magistrate Barthilas, notably along the three ziggurats of the zone. Entering the Gauntlet once started the 45-minute timer to save Ysida Harmon in the original Stratholme.
Gauntlets of the Ancient Shadowmoon are epic mail gloves for elemental shamans.

Garwal is a worgen who is currently hiding in a worg form in western Rivenwood in the Howling Fjord. Managing to trick Ulfang's brothers, Garwal quickly became the alpha worg for reasons unknown. Eating will allow that person to see even through the unnatural magic that Garwal uses to make him invisible to all.
Garunda Mountainpeak is a tauren quest giver located in the Crucible of Flame, through the third Flamegate (in the Scorched Plain) of Mount Hyjal.
Gaudy Winter Veil Sweater is a Feat of Strength for acquiring a Gaudy Winter Veil Sweater during the 2011 Feast of Winter Veil world event.

Gastropods are snails in the Roost of Ji-Kun in the Throne of Thunder. For trash mobs, they are unusually deadly. They cannot be tanked and will instead fixate on random players. Any players caught in front of a moving Gastropod in melee range will be instantly killed. The proper way to kill a Gastropod is to stay out of melee range, taking advantage of its large hitbox. These mobs have been nicknamed "LFR destroyers" thanks to the sheer number of player deaths they tend to leave behind on Raid Finder difficulty, as LFR players, especally new ones doing Throne of Thunder for the first time, are used to mindlessly mowing down trash mobs and tend to get caught unprepared by the one-shot kills.
The Gauntlets of Legion Devastation are a quest reward from Hiding in the Stacks.
The Gate of the Yellow Moon is located in the Strand of the Ancients. It protects the Courtyard of the Ancients.
The Gate of the Purple Amethyst is located in the Strand of the Ancients. The gate protects the western slope leading up to the Gate of the Yellow Moon.
The Gate of the Red Sun is located in the Strand of the Ancients. The gate protects the eastern slope leading up to the Gate of the Yellow Moon.

Gauntlets of Nightmare Manifest drop from elite mobs in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.

Gauntlets of Shackled Elements drop from Star Augur Etraeus in The Nighthold.
Gauntlets of Dreadful Tenacity drops from Brutallus on the Broken Shore.
Gathered Stones would be used to knock down hawk nests, causing Thieving Hen to appear. The Magic Acorn seems to reuse the use effect of this item.
Gauntlets of the Foreseen Conqueror drops from Star Augur Etraeus in The Nighthold.
Gauntlets of the Foreseen Vanquisher drops from Star Augur Etraeus in The Nighthold.
Gauntlets of the Foreseen Protector drops from Star Augur Etraeus in The Nighthold.
Gauntlets of Incalculable Power drops from Watcher Irideus in Halls of Infusion.

Gelkis Village is a centaur village located just to the east and slightly south of Shadowprey Village in southwestern Desolace. It is the principal village of the Gelkis clan, and is situated in a ring around a large ravine. A cluster of cliffs and bluffs in the ravine are connected by a series of bridges and lead to Bolgan's Hole, a cave in the southern mountain face of Desolace. The Gelkis Khan resides within this cave. The entire village is directly adjacent to Desolace's main north-south road and is thus a hazard for many travelers. Recently the centaur have expanded the village some and now have huts on the east side of the road that leads into Feralas, near the lake.
Gelman Stonehand is a mining trainer located in Stonehand Mining in the Dwarven District in Stormwind City.

Gelkak Gyromast is a gnome quest giver located on the Mist's Edge west of the Ruins of Mathystra, all the way north in the night elven zone of Darkshore. He sent adventurers to destroy The Threshwackonator 4100.
__NOTOC__ Gem of Trapped Innocents is a powerful epic caster necklace. It is particularly useful for damage dealing casters.

Gavin's Naze is the last of the four fingers of Hillsbrad and the most protected hill. It is here the Stormpike clan assembles their siege engines, to use against the Forsaken when the time is right. Prior to the dwarves taking the hill, Mountain Lions roamed the area, including the uniquely colored Araga.
Gazlowe's Excavation Site is an unexplored city near Durotar that was excavated by Gazlowe's engineers.

__NOTOC__ Gazban was a goblin wizard located in Stranglethorn Vale. He had the Stone of the Tides which he used to manipulate lesser water elementals on his island. Gazban could be summoned at the Altar of the Tides using Catelyn's Blade and could be found wandering Haunted Isle with the elementals there. "The water elementals were no doubt summoned by Gazban, the goblin wizard rumored to have discovered the Stone of the Tides. As you may know, the Stone of the Tides curses its bearer, causing him to fade in and out of existence..." When attacked, he turned into a water elemental. He was killed and the stone retrieved.

Gaz Soulripper was an orcish warlock of the Shadow Council when the new warchief, Orgrim Doomhammer, came upon them in a surprise attack and slew nearly every last member, including Gaz. Shortly after, Gaz's former master, Gul'dan, brought the orc back and placed his spirit, along with those of his fellow council members, in the decaying bodies of the Knights of Azeroth. Thus the death knights were born. Ultimately, the Horde was defeated and the Portal destroyed. Gaz found himself trapped on Draenor along with Teron Gorefiend and Ragnok Bloodreaver. Gelbin is a blood elf stable master found next to the inn of Krom'gar Fortress in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Gazrix is a goblin flight master located at Nozzlepot's Outpost in the Northern Barrens.

Gavin Marlsbury is a worgen located in the northeastern passageway between the Trade District and the Canals in Stormwind City. He is stealthed and wields two daggers.

Gaze of the Black Prince is a buff that passively doubles The Black Prince reputation standing gains and increases the drop chances on the legendary quest items: Sigil of Power, Sigil of Wisdom, Titan Runestone, and Secrets of the Empire. It is automatically active on all characters during designated time windows, and persists through death, logging out, and similar interruptions until Blizzard deactivates it itself.
__NOTOC__ Gauros Earthshatter is a tauren found in Brawl'gar Arena.
Gelgothar is an annihilan that appears in various locations during the Legion Invasion. He later attacks the Sepulcher of the Sky in Highmountain during Legion Assaults.
Gazarogg the Stonespeaker is a drogbar located in the Deep Roads of Highmountain. He is guarded by a Bound Elemental.
Gazes of the Inquisition are guardian eyes located in Val'sharah and Highmountain during Legion Assaults.
The General's Cache can be found in Ulduar after defeating General Vezax after destroying the Saronite Animus.

General's Mooncloth Belt is sold by Kezzik the Striker in the Netherstorm for 1 Mark of Honor.
General's Mooncloth Slippers are sold by Kezzik the Striker in the Netherstorm for 2 Mark of Honor.
Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle is a Venture Company leper gnome found in the Stonetalon Mountains. Ziz Fizziks wants Gerenzo's mechanical arm. Professor Xakxak Gyromate wants Gerenzo dead.

Gerard was a villager and farmer that lived in a village near Strahnbrad with his wife Matilda. He had his ledger, a document full of vital information regarding his farm, stolen by Menag of the Bloodhill Bandits when Arthas was near a bridge to Strahnbrad. Arthas killed Menag and gave the ledger back, and for that action Gerard rewarded Arthas with a Tome of Strength.

General Fangore, formerly known as Lieutenant Fangore, is a Shadowhide gnoll located in the eastern Redridge Mountains. Back then, Magistrate Solomon wanted Fangore's cold, dead paw, for his alliance with the warlock Morganth, as he rallied his forces around the Tower of Ilgalar, Morganth's bastion in Redridge. Sometime after the Cataclysm, a new Fangore appears to have replaced the original as warlord of the Shadowhide gnolls. This Fangore was promoted to general by Grand Magus Doane, the new master of the Shadowhide gnolls and the Tower of Ilgalar. Bravo Company slew General Fangore in order to get the Key of Ilgalar. Geofram Bouldertoe is a dwarf mining trainer located in the shop Deepmountain Mining & Jewelcrafting, on the north side of the Great Forge in Ironforge.
Gerald Crawley is a human poison vendor located in Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains.
Gereck is an orc stable master located in Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains.

General Kirika is an orc quest giver located at the Hive'Regal Horde camp in Silithus. Following the end of the Burning Legion's third invasion, as several bodies of the Orgrimmar Legion were found in the destroyed Silithus, it is unclear if General Kirika managed to escape or perished as well.

Gerard Abernathy is a Forsaken found in the War Quarter of the Undercity. He has a human mindslave named Theresa, which he shows off to his companions, Leona Tharpe and Joanna Whitehall.

The Geyser Fields is an area of land filled with geysers in the Borean Tundra. While machines have taken control of the northern sections some undead nerubian have taken control of the southern parts. Systems of hot spring pools surround the geyser fields on all sides. There's Steam Springs to the west, the Scalding Pools to the east, and the Festering Pools to the north. The Fizzcrank Pumping Station, an oil platform the gnomes built to make fuel for their flying machines, sits in the geyser fields, where a hydrothermal system connects it to the Fizzcrank Airstrip. There are enough natural oil seeps around that you see oil-soaked wildlife too. The whole place stinks of sulfur (and far worse
Genesis is a talent in the Druids Balance tree; you will need to spend 8 points in Balance to max it. This talent increases the healing of the druid's heal over time abilities.

This guide will explain several methods of getting yourself to Wintergrasp and Dalaran before NPCs will teleport you, and without using another person to do so. Very low level characters will die during the trip, so be sure to remove your weapons and armor if you do not want a significant repair bill in the end.

General Vezax is the twelfth boss encounter in Ulduar. He can be found in the Descent into Madness guarding the Prison of Yogg-Saron. Mana-based classes will have to deal with a lock on their regen, but will be able to restore it by destroying crystals that drop a residue on the floor. The Elite mode requires players not to break any of these crystals and not regen any mana. Vezax is a "memory" in the fight against Argent Confessor Paletress in the Trial of the Champion encounter of the Crusaders' Coliseum.

Geologist's Ledger - Overloaded Elements is a profession achievement earned by discovering and documenting the effects of overloading every element empowered ore vein across the Dragon Isles.
Ghost Wolf is a shaman ability. It transforms the shaman into the form of a ghost wolf, increasing movement speed by 30%. It is learned at level 10, or from the Exile's Reach quest A Shaman's Duty.

Giants are a type of creature similar to humanoids, but of the very large sort (above 3 meters or so), and larger than most ogres. The category includes most semi-intelligent and some intelligent large humanoids. Most giants are elite. Many of the giants on Azeroth were created by the Keepers as part of their ordering of Azeroth in the Forge of Wills, meant to protect and oversee the land and ocean. According to Brann Bronzebeard, most of Azeroth's giants were hit with the Curse of Flesh, but it doesn't seem to have affected them much. Only a handful remain in the most untouched areas of Azeroth, where they are still fulfilling their ancient duties, although some (molten giants and Baron Kaz
Ghostweave Gloves are a pair of gloves that give a bonus to intellect and mana regeneration.
The Ghostweave Vest is a cloth vest made by Tailoring which give s bonus to intellect and mana regeneration.
Giant Foreststriders are tallstriders found in Darkshore prior to the Shattering.

The Ghostweave is not a true set in that it does not give set bonuses. The individual pieces give bonuses to mana regeneration (MP/5) and intellect. Therefore this set will most benefit a Mage or Priest.

Ghun was the youngest warlock of the Frostwolf clan on Draenor during the orcish war against the draenei. He was an idealist and was not fond of the demonic allies and warlock magic he was forced to use in combat. He questioned why he was no longer allowed to try and communicate with the elements and the ancestors, in response to Gul'dan's orders. Durotan was unable to provide a real answer, instead telling him to keep quiet, and that it was for the good of the clan. He also warned him that he might not be able to protect him if he didn't obey orders. His status afterwards is unknown.

This questing guide for the zone of Ghostlands details an efficient method to obtain and complete the quests in Ghostlands. For a list of all Ghostlands quests in a sortable table, see Ghostlands quests. Note: The questing guides are not meant for power-leveling purposes. Rather, they are meant to show players the most efficient way to complete all quests available for a particular zone. If you know of a better order or method to accomplish this, your input is welcome (in fact, greatly desired). For major changes, feel free to edit, but make a note in the talk page as to your reasoning.
__NOTOC__ The Ghostly Skull can be purchased for from Darahir in the Underbelly of the city of Dalaran.

In Warcraft III:The Frozen Throne, ghostly Archmagi are the souls of the dead Archmagi who died while preventing the invasion of Arthas in Dalaran. They have the same spells like of a regular Archmage but appear as its luminescent counterpart. In the Blood Elf campaign, they appear in Chapter 3 where Kael and Lady Vashj encountered several of them. Defeating them grants an item called the Archmagi Ring that grants a mana regeneration aura or the Brilliance Aura. In order to get the item, the player must first gather all the pieces of the ring by defeating all the ghostly archmagi, who drop the pieces.

__NOTOC__ Ghostcrawler is a rare spectral crab that patrols the entire Abandoned Reef area of Vashj'ir. It will also randomly phase in and out much like a warp stalker making locating it that much more of a challenge. Ghostcrawler will phase out every 15 to 30 seconds, even while in combat, making defeating him solo or in a small group impossible. This is done to give hunters the ability to tame the beast without having other players kill it first.

The Ghastly Confines can be found deep inside the Niuzao Catacombs underneath the Niuzao Temple on the big island off the western coast of Townlong Steppes. The confines were originally the prison of the , who has since escaped and left the behind.

Giant Catfish are fish located in Darnassus. They gobble whatever is shiny. On one occasion a giant catfish ate Sister Aquinne's pendant during a boat ride with Astaia. Since then, Astaia tries to catch the fish who gobbled the pendant. Filleting this fish will reveal Aquinne's Moon Pendant.

Ghost in the Mist is a Restoration shaman artifact trait. It is linked to the Pull of the Sea, Refreshing Currents, Empowered Droplets and Sense of Urgency traits.
Ghostblade Scouts are void elves located at the Stormwind Embassy in Stormwind City. They can be also seen roaming the streets of the Dwarven District, Cathedral Square, and Trade District.
Ssinkrix is a rat located in the Canals in Stormwind City and in Orgrimmar. It is hiding in a Weathered Supply Crate.

__NOTOC__ Gezzrok the Keeper is a flamewaker found in Ragnaros' Lair in the Molten Core during the quest Molten Core (quest). Thaelin Darkanvil asked him for a Fragment o' the Molten Core for the Black Anvil, and Gezzrok gave it to him after the Alliance adventurer proved his strength in a duel with Gezzrok.
Ghern the Rancid is a vargul who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.

Giant Mushrooms are mushrooms that are taken care of by the Stone Trogg Fungalmancers in the Needlerock Chasm in Deepholm. They are apparently used to spawn Fungal Monstrosities and must be destroyed for Sprout No More.

Giant's Handkerchief drops from Drugon the Frostblood in Highmountain.
Giant Ocean Ottuks are ottuks located in the Aerie Chasm and on Morqut Islet in the Forbidden Reach.

The kingdom of Gilneas (pronounced "Gil-NEIGH-uhs"), or the Gilnean kingdom, is one of the seven human kingdoms and is located in the peninsula of Gilneas, situated southwest of Silverpine Forest on the continent of Lordaeron. It is ruled by King Genn Greymane of the Greymane family. After the events of the Cataclysm, Gilneas rejoined the Alliance, and they have been trying to reclaim their homeland ever since. The nation's colors are described as a red design consisting of a circle with three vertical lines, akin to lances, and another line bisecting the circle itself, all set within a field of gray.

:"I felt my muscles thicken, my skin harden, and my senses sharpen." :—Taheo Skyspeaker Gift of the Wild is the group version of the druid buff spell Mark of the Wild. It affects all party or raid members of level 40 or higher. In addition to affecting the entire party or raid, it also lasts for a full hour, instead of 30 min. Aside from the mana cost, duration, and number of targets affected, the spell is identical to Gift of the Wild and all talents and glyphs that improve one spell also improve the other. In patch 4.0.1, this ability was removed, and Mark of the Wild affects all characters in the player's raid group.

Gikkix is a goblin fish and drink vendor located at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris. Like most residents of Steamwheedle Port, he has gone missing and was possibly killed by the destructive wave that destroyed the port.
using the Gift of the Naaru.]] Gift of the Naaru is a racial ability of the draenei. It restores 20% of the target's total health over 5 seconds.
Gilded Trousers of Benediction drop from Doomwalker in Shadowmoon Valley. It can also drop from Doomwalker in Tanaris during WoW's Anniversary.

Giant eagles are large eagles that live on Azeroth and inside the Emerald Dream. Some were trained as mounts by the blood elf dragonhawk units of the island of Quel'Danas. They can be summoned by druids as nature's allies. The giant eagles are fully described in Appendix Three of Manual of Monsters, however, the validity of the source is disputed.

, an island-sized turtle.]] Giant turtles (also known as giant sea turtles, great sea turtles, and sea turtles) are larger versions of the average species of turtles. Giant turtles are used as means of transportation by different races. They can be found both in the southern and northern seas of Azeroth, as indicated respectively by those used as submarines during the Second War and those used currently as boats by the tuskarr. Some giant turtles fled the then-corrupt Teldrassil, only to die when they beached themselves in Darkshore. Others used to frolic around Nordrassil before it was sacrificed in the Third War. Giant turtles are known to live in the Veiled Sea as well.

The Gilded Rose is the inn located in the Trade District. It is a popular resting point for travelers passing through the human capital of Stormwind City due to its proximity to the bank, Auction House, and an ever-popular mailbox. Its name is readable from the sign outside. Innkeeper Allison is the host and offers a Hearthstone point as well as being a vendor of food and drink.

Giant frost wolves are a type of frost wolf. The tauren believe that giant frost wolves are touched by the spirits of winter, and are granted some of their power. Whatever the case, these gigantic blue-gray furred creatures are most common in the far north. They are unafraid of humans or other races and hunt them as much as any other prey. Giant frost wolves are much like larger versions of dire frost wolves, though they are notably less timid. They do hunt in packs but rely on simple tactics -- two halves of the pack converge on a victim with great speed. They are also found in Northrend, where they are hunted by ice trolls.

The gilgoblins, sometimes called gilblins, gill goblins, water-goblins, or kelfin are a species of aquatic goblin that live within the ocean. They were first introduced into the game with the Cataclysm expansion and can mainly be found in the deep sea in areas like Vashj'ir and Nazjatar, though other groups have invaded the coasts of the Swamp of Sorrows, Azsuna, and Stormsong Valley as well. King Gurboggle is the self-proclaimed king of at least Gurboggle's Ledge.

Gilnean was the planned native language of the Gilneas humans. The language appeared for a brief time during World of Warcraft: Cataclysm beta, but the ability to speak it did not make it to the live game. Instead, Gilneans speak Common.
Gilnean Survivors are humans found in Gilneas City and along the road to Keel Harbor in Gilneas.
Gilnean Refugees are citizens of Gilneas found throughout the Howling Oak of Darnassus following their exodus from Gilneas. They are welcomed to the city by the druids of Darnassus.

Gilnean Emissaries were worgen Battle for Gilneas recruiters located at various spots throughout the largest Alliance cities - Stormwind City, Exodar, Darnassus, and Ironforge during the monthly Call to Arms: Battle for Gilneas.

Gilnean Crows are critters found in Gilneas City and other places of Gilneas, seen in small flocks, often around corpses. They are notable because they take more than one hit to kill (one must be fast with ranged attacks to slay one), and upon dropping out of the sky, they can be looted like how critters used to be. However, they do not yield any loot.
Gilnean Militias are Gilnean freedom fighters that fought against the Forsaken during The Battle for Gilneas City.
Gilnean Mastiffs are level 3-13 mastiffs found in Gilneas and Gilneas City.
Gift of Winter's Veil is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Gib the Banana-Hoarder is a rare monkey found just to the northwest of Splinterspear Junction in the Swamp of Sorrows. He looks exactly like the Darkmoon Monkey.

Gilded Fist is an ability used by a pet during a Pet Battle.

Gilnean Officers are worgen located in Drustvar. They are members of the Gilneas Brigade, and only spawn during the quest Dogged Tenacity, where they defend their camp at the Brackish Coast alongside Hunting Hounds and their leader, Marshal Layre.

Giddy's Crawler is located in Bondo's Yard on Mechagon Island. It's the mount of Giddy Gallon.

Gila Crosswires is the gnomish personal assistant of Tinkmaster Overspark. Initially seen in Nazjatar, she accompanies Overspark on the expedition from Boralus to Mechagon Island. During the final stage of the War Campaign, she is also in Razor Hill in Durotar along with Overspark and Gazlowe.

The Gift of the Void drops from Vexiona in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.

Gjalerbron (pronounced "Shalerbron") is a vrykul fortress located in the mountains in the northern area of the Howling Fjord. Here, the vrykul — aided by the Scourge — conduct rituals, both to awaken long slumbering vrykul and presumably to raise dead vrykul as undead warriors. The Waking Halls can be found through an entrance on the lower tier, while Winter's Terrace can be found in the main structure. A secret tunnel is being dug to Gjalerbron from below Utgarde Keep. After the war against the Jailer, Muradin Bronzebeard reported that the area is still half-filled with slumbering vrykul, slowly being coaxed back to waking life by the vrykul necrolords. A girallon is a magical beast with low intelligence. Dryads will sometimes use their empathy to influence these creatures.

Gina Tomson is the daughter of Thomas and Suzannah Thomson. At her husband's urgings, Suzannah tried to bring herself and her children to the distant land of Kalimdor in order to escape the undead Scourge. However complications prevented them from leaving. Thomas, the future Headless Horseman, would come to the conclusion that a storm destroyed the last ship fleeing to Kalimdor. In time, the Thomson's hiding spot from the undead would come under attack by the paranoid and zealous humans of the Scarlet Crusade. Ironically enough the one to kill Gina, her brother, and her mother would be her own father, who wouldn't recognize them until it was too late.
